title: 低位勾跟对压
description: 水粉描绘膝高岩包上的低位勾跟，成人仍贴近完整软垫。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult working a low heel-hook compression position. A broad rounded volume at knee height accepts the heel, the other shoe presses a positive foothold, and two large opposing handholds support a compact torso close to the wall. Keep the action entirely low over thick uninterrupted crash mats, with an empty landing zone extending beyond the figure. Use an oblique medium-wide angle so the hooked heel and supporting foot remain readable. Paint matte forest green, burnt orange, and cream surfaces. Show control and plausible adult anatomy, without a leap, extreme contortion, writing, brands, or dramatic exposure.
